description: Scenario tests for content-pillars. A run passes only when every item in 'expect' is satisfied. Written before the skill body (test-first).

evals.name: happy-path-derive-pillars
evals.input: Help me figure out my content pillars.
expect: reads brand-profile (or runs it first if missing) rather than brainstorming blind
mines positioning, POV, audience pains, and proof for candidates
selects 3-5 pillars that each pass the ownable/relevant/strategic/sustainable test
identifies exactly one signature pillar
writes a content-pillars.md following the template

evals.name: rejects-generic-buckets
evals.input: My pillars are educational, behind-the-scenes, and promotional. Flesh those out.
expect: explains that those are intents/formats, not pillars (themes)
converts them into real ownable themes derived from the brand
does NOT accept the generic buckets as the pillar set

evals.name: ownability-required
evals.input: Give me content pillars for my business.
expect: for each pillar, states a specific reason THIS brand can own it
rejects pillars that 'anyone could post' as not ownable
ties each pillar back to something real in the brand profile

evals.name: sustainability-test
evals.context: One proposed pillar is very narrow (a single product feature).
expect: applies the 10+ ideas sustainability test
flags the narrow pillar as a topic, not a pillar, or broadens it to the audience problem it solves
keeps only pillars that can sustain ongoing content

evals.name: too-many-narrow-to-3-5
evals.input: I want to post about 10 different topics. Make them all pillars.
expect: narrows to the 3-5 strongest, clustering overlapping topics
explains that too many pillars means no focus
produces a coherent, ownable set

evals.name: balance-and-signature
evals.input: Build my pillars — and I want most of it to sell our product.
expect: keeps a conversion/product pillar to the minority
ensures supporting pillars carry audience value and connection
identifies a non-promotional signature pillar as the differentiator

evals.name: personal-brand-adaptation
evals.input: I'm a solo creator — what should my content pillars be?
expect: frames pillars as person-led (what they're known for, journey, craft)
ties pillars to the individual, not a faceless topic list
still produces ownable, sustainable themes

evals.name: existing-pillars-loaded
expect: loads the existing pillars rather than re-deriving them
summarizes them and proceeds (hands off to batch-content-plan)
only re-runs the exercise if the user asks to revisit
